diagnoses.analysis: The new asyncProviderTelemetryFailureDoesNotAffectResult test incorrectly requires RPC server-context object identity to survive completion. Dubbo 3.3.6 natively restores a copied context in AsyncRpcResult.whenCompleteWithContext; RpcContext.RestoreContext copies and replaces the server attachment, independently of instrumentation or telemetry errors. Remove only that unsupported identity assertion and its setup, preserving response-success, caller-context and exactly-one-end-attempt assertions and all cleanup. The original failure was reproduced locally. All four affected library suites pass afterward with both pinned latest and baseline dependencies, and existing Java formatting/checkstyle checks pass. No production behavior or dependency version changes are needed.

<!--

a deprecation or breaking change.

Keep Dubbo provider spans recording until asynchronous results complete, capturing the full duration and failures carried by either the future or response. Port only the Dubbo slice from #20675, stacked on #20721.

- **Compatibility:** Use `Result.whenCompleteWithContext` where available, `AsyncRpcResult.getResultFuture` on 2.7.0, and a `CompletionStage` fallback on 2.7.2; preserve client and synchronous behavior.
- **Coverage:** Add direct completion/error tests and shared delayed-provider integration tests for library and javaagent instrumentation, retaining legacy, RPC preview, and duplicate telemetry assertions. Pin additional javaagent suites to Dubbo 2.7.0 and 2.7.2.
metadata.title: End Dubbo provider spans on asynchronous completion
